_comment: These decide what this server permits; each player still chooses how they climb within it.
A player's own setting and the limit here are compared, and the SLOWER of the two is used.
enabled: false switches the mod off for everyone here, exactly as if it were not installed.
upSpeedLimit: fastest ascent allowed, in blocks per tick. Vanilla climbs at 0.2.
downSpeedLimit: fastest descent allowed, in blocks per tick. Negative. Vanilla slides at -0.15.
Players without the mod are unaffected either way.
